3764
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
WHEREAS, experience has shown that the utilization of
irrigation pump systems has considerably increased the
crop yield per hectare; .
WHEREAS, it is in the interest of the effective implementa
tion of the irrigation program that the pump units now
being maintained, operated and/or held by the Irrigation
Pump Administration be transferred to the Irrigation
Service Unit of the Department of Agriculture and Natural
Resources, there to be rehabilitated and ultimately sold to
farmers associations;
NoW, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby authorize the Secretary of Agriculture and
Natural Resources to transfer all irrigation pump systems
complete with accessories presently being administered,
maintained and/or held by the Irrigation Pump Adminis-
tration to the Irrigation Service Unit of the Department
of Agriculture and Natural Resources at appraised value
to be determined by a committee which the Secretary of
Agriculture and Natural Resources shall create for the
To facilitate the rehabilitation and sale of the irrigation
pump systems, the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural
Resources is hereby authorized to enter into agreement
with the Philippine Counci! for United States Aid and
the Mutual Security Agency Special Technical and Econo-
mic Mission relative to financing the rehabilitation of the
irrigation pump systems and liquidation of current obliga-
tions of the Irrigation Pump Administration other than
that owing to the Natioral Treasury of the Philippines
represented by the P2 million revolving fund allotted by the
Central Bank to the National Government for the Depart-
ment of Agriculture and Natural Resources for irrigation
pump projects pursuant to Republic Act No. 266.
The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources,
through the Irrigation Service Unit, shall rehabilitate and/
or reinstall these pump systems and sell them to farmers
associations at the price made up exclusively of the cost
of acquisition plus the cost of rehabilitation and other per-
tinent charges to be determined by the same aforemen-
tioned committee: Provided, however, That in no case shall
the price of the rehabilitated pump systems exceed the cost
of irrigation pump systems of comparable size and equip-
ment when new: and Provided, further, That purchasers
of the rehabilitated irrigation pump systems shall acquire
ownership of the same free from all liens and encumbrances,
except those provided by law.
So much of the gross proceeds of sale of the pump sys-
tems as will be necessary shall first be applied to the settle
ment of whatever amount may be owing to the Counterpart
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
Fund Special Account by virtue of such agreement or agree-
ments that may be entered into by the Secretary of Agri-
culture and Natural Resources with the Philippine Council
for United States Aid and the Mutual Security Agency
Special Technical and Economic Mission pursuant hereto,
and the balance of the proceeds left thereafter shall be
turned over to the Treasury of the Philippines to the credit
of the Irrigation Pump Administration and applied to the
liquidation of the aforementioned F2 million revolving fund
allotted by the Central Bank to the National Government for
the Department of Agriculture *and Natural Resources for
irrigation pump projecis pursuant to Republic Act No. 2.66.
Done. in the City of Manila, this 14th day of September,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines "
